requirements.text: Return the number k of distinct values.
Modify the caller-visible array so its first k entries contain the unique values.
Preserve sorted order and include each distinct value exactly once.
Handle signed, singleton, all-equal, and maximum-size sorted arrays.

reference_complexity.auxiliary_space: O(1) auxiliary space; the provided driver stores/serializes O(K) result data
reference_complexity.notes: Reference guidance, not an assessment of submitted source. Include stored input, serialized output, returned arrays, and stacks in total space. In-place/constant-space compliance is reviewed manually under Technical Quality; no automatic memory or complexity score is added. Difficulty follows LeetCode and the suggested practice duration is provisional.
